messages:
morgan: Heads-up  support keeps linking three different pages for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. Can we ship a single compact playbook with small SDK snippets?
alejandra: Yes. Proposal: top-level decision matrix, 2-line header-inspection snippets, 6-line py/js examples for jittered backoff, and a tiny trim_history example with token counts.
todd: Strong +1. Also include a short "deployment differences" note: hosted uses Retry-After and standard rate headers; dedicated may expose vendor-specific headers.
alm: I can draft the py headers snippet: ```python
ra = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
delay = int(ra) if ra and ra.isdigit() else base_backoff
await sleep(delay + random.random())
```
alejandra: Node snippet: ```js
const ra = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after']||'0',10)||base;
await sleep(ra + Math.random()*ra);
```
morgan: Add a tiny table mapping symptom->fallback name->sdk helper: 429 -> retry_with_backoff -> client.fallback.retryWithBackoff(), timeout -> retry_with_backoff (idempotent) -> client.retry(), context_limit -> trim_context -> client.fallback.trimContext(). Keep wording canonical.
todd: Put the decision matrix first so support can link quickly. Also add FAQ: "When not to trim" and a changelog blurb.
support-bot: PR opened #3829 "compact-error-playbook + tiny sdk snippets" (labels: docs, needs-review)
morgan: Scheduled review 9:30am PT. After merge, ping #support and #eng-runtime with the canonical URL. Thanks!
